incident-bot: [P1] hosted-api queue growth alert for hosted-us-west - queue_length=24,120, p95=2.9s, p99=12.1s, GPU_util=100% :warning: 
incident-bot: bridge: https://zoom.redwood/incident/1829995555 · runbook: /runbooks/hosted-queue-backlog
maya: paging — taking it. joining bridge now.
liam: I see a ton of 429s from cloud provisioner in the logs: `quotaExceeded` and `rateLimitExceeded`. provisioner retries are backing off.
priya: autoscaler failing to create instances due to cloud quota + api rate limits. stacktrace snippet: ```ProvisionerError: createVMs failed: 429 quotaExceeded (retry 6/6)```
sasha: Support seeing lots of 502 & client timeouts, customers reporting webhook delays and failed chatbot replies. top affected tenants: ABC, campaigner, marketing-surge.
tom: ABC (enterprise) is at ~20% error rate, raising severity with their CSM.
maya: quick mitigations applying now: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller model variants for non-prod and low-tier customers; 2) throttle known noisy tenants; 3) reduce max_tokens for top heavy tenants.
liam: applied rate-limit rule rl-342 to tenant:campaigner (requests/sec cap). Also temporarily bumped per-tenant concurrency cap down for non-paid tiers.
priya: manual scale-up blocked by cloud quota. I've opened support ticket CLOUD-8921 with provider requesting quota bump. Meanwhile provisioner logs show slow VM create loops, avoid restarts for now.
maya: evicting stuck long-running batches older than 60s to free up slots — running: `redwoodctl evict --pool hosted-us-west --age 60s`
sasha: pushed config change to reduce max_tokens to 256 for top10 tenants (rollout 30s). expected token consumption down ~18-25%.
incident-bot: note: automatic fallback auto-rollback scheduled in 30m if queue < 5k for consecutive checks.
maya: handing off to evening oncall dave at 1830 UTC — dave please ack and take bridge. summary: peak q=24.1k, p99 12.1s, cause = cloud quota + provisioner rate limiting + tenant fanout. mitigations: fallback routes, tenant throttles, eviction, token caps. customers impacted: ABC (enterprise), campaigner, marketing-surge.
dave: ack — joining bridge and will monitor. planning to enable cross-region spill to eu-west if provisioner doesn't recover within 20m.
priya: digging traces: campaigner tenant emitted many tiny fanout requests (100->1000 fanout) which killed batching efficiency. recommend tenant-level fanout allowlist + guide.
tom: customer ops will notify ABC with ETA ~1h and list mitigation steps taken.
incident-bot: periodic check: queue_length=14,200, p95=1.8s, p99=7.3s (5m since last).
dave: monitoring dashboards and logs. next update in 10m or on major change. if autoscaler still failing, we'll enable region-spill and promote smaller-model fallback for paid tiers too.
